tasks.title: Private incidents never enter notification detection, seeding or delivery
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, all Files/Behavior/Checks/Completion evidence; R8, corrected R6 consumer use and decision 9. Pin the merged contract 1.8.0 full SHA and update bun.lock with bun install. fetchManualIncidents skips private raw items before validation without rejected entries/logging/counting, then projects accepted public incidents. Keep config, metrics, ledger, routing and event keys unchanged. Implement all five fake-api/catch-all/component-channel checks: second-poll private suppression with public A as a positive control; notes and a draft update on A served in the same response as new public marker B, then await the poll and channel writes and observe B before asserting absence; draft-to-published delivery after first-start seeding; restart deduplication; silent skips. Update all three docs. Include security, failing-on-main and CPU evidence; deploy owns compose-e2e.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail; after an empty first poll and then A/I/D, catch-all and matching component channels each hold exactly 1 manual:A:opened and 0 lines for I or D. After serving A with note/draft-update sentinels alongside new public marker B and awaiting that poll's writes, both channels hold exactly 1 manual:B:opened; only then assert 0 sentinel payload lines and 0 update events for A. A draft D seen on first start, then published publicly with publication-time createdAt, sends exactly 1 manual:D:opened; restart with the same ledger adds 0 duplicate lines. Private skips produce 0 rejected entries and 0 log entries. Focused coverage may fail the global threshold.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the complete suite pass with the unchanged 0.8 line-coverage threshold.

With a local fake API and disposable file-channel/ledger configuration, the running service emits the public control once and emits 0 private sentinel lines; the PR records command and output evidence without secrets.
exit 0; record branch and pre-change main test_cpu_s on the same machine and include both numbers in the PR as requested by Performance impact.

PR records the pre-change main SHA and demonstrates Checks 1 and 3 failing there, check results, live file-channel smoke and before/after CPU numbers. It maps each applicable Security impact item to a test/command with output: no note/draft/token leak, raw privacy filtering before validation and a merged contract 1.8.0 full-SHA pin with no unrelated dependency change. It states internal-only incidents reach 0 channels and records unchanged public event keys, seeding, routing and restart behavior.
